The '''Vorkaa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Vorkaan delegation]], which met with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Minister of State]] [[Mokka Falanthas]]<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', which occur in parallel with [[Mokka Falanthas]]' meeting with the [[Vorkaan delegation]], to [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vorkaa system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square I-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
